headline: Letter of Award from Power Grid Corp for 6,000 MW Barmer-South Kalamb HVDC terminal station
source: Exchange filing (via arthneeti.com) / GE Vernova press release
note: LOA for a large HVDC project from PGCIL; definitive agreement and contract value not yet disclosed per the filing - genuinely provisional, not a signed order.

headline: Q2 FY27 net profit up 64% YoY to Rs 427cr, stock hits 52-week high; FY27 plan of 84 new Kalyan + 6 international + 50 Candere stores, full Candere ownership taken
note: Concrete, disclosed FY27 store-count expansion plan alongside a strong results beat - not just a results-only catalyst.

headline: Confirmed roadmap of 5 major vehicle launches (SUVs, EV, LCV) by June 2027, announced on Q2 FY27 earnings call
note: Officially confirmed on the earnings call, not speculation, though no revenue target disclosed for the new launches.

headline: USFDA approved ILUMYA for active psoriatic arthritis, expanding beyond its original psoriasis indication
note: Completed regulatory approval (not pending), a genuinely new addressable patient population for an existing drug.

headline: Zudio crossed 1,000 stores milestone during Q2 FY27, reported alongside results
note: Exact announcement date approximate (within the Nov 2026 Q2 FY27 reporting window for Tata retail cos) - the milestone itself is concrete and disclosed.

headline: Unveiled 4 production-ready models at EICMA 2026 (Milan) for a European market push; targets 30%+ international revenue by 2030
note: Officially presented by the company at a major industry show, not a rumor. October 2026 sales also strong (+29% YoY, EV +120%) as supporting context.

headline: Four 2x800MW ultra-supercritical thermal project orders from Adani Power (reported value Rs 20,000-28,000cr, varies by source)
note: Also won a separate ~Rs 600-900cr Power Grid synchronous-condenser order on Nov 7, 2026. Exact Adani order value disputed across sources (Rs 5,000-7,000cr per contract per one source vs the aggregate headline) - left SizeScore unscored rather than guess a percentage of revenue.

headline: Tentative USFDA approval for twice-yearly HIV PrEP injectable lenacapavir across 120 PEPFAR nations
note: Source only says "early November 2026" - exact date approximate. Tentative (not full) approval, hence provisional confirmation tier; large addressable population (120 nations) under a Gilead voluntary license.

headline: Signed a 5-year engineering and R&D services contract with Nokia for India operations
note: Contract value not disclosed.

headline: Q2 FY27: profit more than doubled to Rs 232cr; 165 net new stores (143 in India across 61 new cities)
note: Concrete, disclosed city-count expansion alongside results, same pattern as Kalyan Jewellers earlier. Separately: early investors (incl. SoftBank, ~Rs7500cr) have been selling down post-lockup - not scored as a risk trigger since this is VC/financial-investor selling, not promoter selling, but worth human awareness.

headline: APSEZ agreed to acquire 100% of Evos B.V., Europe's 2nd-largest independent liquid storage operator, for an EV of EUR2.56bn
note: Signed, binding acquisition agreement (regulatory approval pending for closing, not for the deal itself). Expands global footprint to 28 ports/terminals across 10 countries.

headline: Expanded IFC partnership incl. a $150M social loan for rural women in agriculture, and launched an Innovation Hub with APIX at Singapore Fintech Festival
note: Modest in size relative to SBI scale - correctly scored low given the partnership type weight.

headline: Won Noida Metro Aqua Line extension order (Heavy Civil Infrastructure business, Significant category)
note: Exact value undisclosed; L&T's own "Significant" banding typically implies Rs1,000-2,500cr.

headline: USFDA final approval for generic estradiol/levonorgestrel transdermal patch (menopause therapy), ~$45.7M US market size
note: 180-day Competitive Generic Therapy exclusivity.

headline: USFDA final approval for perampanel tablets (epilepsy), ~$67M US market size, launch scheduled Q3 FY27
note: Approval is final, but commercial launch not yet happened (scheduled Q3 FY27) - revenue impact is still ahead.

headline: Acquired 82% stake in Simply Nam Beauty for up to Rs33cr, alongside Q2 FY27 results (profit +207% YoY)
note: Small deal size but management described it as unlocking a new brand/growth vector.

headline: Agreed to acquire 70% stake in Armed Cell Therapeutics (Dutch cell therapy firm) for EUR48 million
note: Part of a stated long-term strategy to build a global, innovation-led pharma business - genuinely new therapeutic area (cell therapy), not an extension of existing generics business.

headline: Record conductor order book Rs12,025cr (51% export share) as of Sep 30, 2026; Q2 FY27 new order inflow Rs4,775cr, 2x YoY; won first-ever Scandinavian order
note: First Scandinavian order (Z-shaped conductors) is a genuine new-geography entry on top of the overall order book record.

headline: Selected as strategic technology partner by EBRD (European Bank for Reconstruction and Development) for 5 years, covering Run-Change-Transform tech portfolio incl. AI work
note: Deal value not disclosed.

headline: Board cleared 660MW expansion at Ghatampur (via NUPPL), Rs2,500cr bond-funding plan, and a 100MW wind PPA with SJVN
note: Brownfield expansion within existing Ghatampur premises; board-approved, not speculative.

headline: Third consecutive natural gas discovery in Andaman/KG basin exploration campaign, reducing exploration risk
note: No production/reserve size disclosed yet - early-stage discovery, not yet monetized.
